metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Thunderbird file attach dialog, navigate file system, select files, confirm attachment.
metadata.explanation: Chains the proven attach goal with saving as draft. Getter recursively searches Thunderbird Drafts MBOX files for 'aws-bill.pdf' filename reference. Initial state has no draft with attachment, so evaluator will not pass spuriously. [Fixed: evaluator.func was missing check_ prefix; updated from 'thunderbird_draft_attachment__ac90f87152777ec474b581760325d43f' to 'check_thunderbird_draft_attachment__ac90f87152777ec474b581760325d43f' to match actual metric function name]
fix_history: Fix 1: Added missing check_ prefix to evaluator.func field to match actual metric function name 'check_thunderbird_draft_attachment__ac90f87152777ec474b581760325d43f'

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly searches Thunderbird MBOX Drafts files for 'aws-bill.pdf' string, jointly verifying both sub-goals: (1) email saved as draft, (2) attachment present.
Metric logic correctly checks result['draft_with_attachment'] and returns 1.0 if true — semantically aligned with the instruction requirements.
State is read from persistent MBOX files on disk; no postconfig needed.
Coverage is complete: a single grep over Drafts MBOX files simultaneously confirms draft existence and attachment presence.
Parameter handling: metric ignores 'expected' but hardcodes equivalent logic to the rules dict {'draft_with_attachment': true}, which is correct.
Minor concern: grep for literal 'aws-bill.pdf' assumes filename is not MIME-encoded; for plain ASCII filenames Thunderbird stores them unencoded, so this is unlikely to cause issues in practice.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional: also grep for 'aws-bill' (without extension) or use a case-insensitive match to guard against any minor filename variation in MIME headers.
